_comment: Written by `showtime new --from-storyboard`: the plan. Scene ids are the <section> ids in index.html and the ## headings in narration.md. `showtime retime --from-voice` reads it to say where the voice outgrew a shot's planned length.

rows.visual: Close-up of a chessboard where White plays a natural-looking move (e.g. 14. Qxe4??). An ominous red Stockfish eval bar drops from +3.2 down to -4.5.
rows.brief: Close-up of a chessboard where White plays a natural-looking move (e.g. 14. Qxe4??). An ominous red Stockfish eval bar drops from +3.2 down to -4.5.
onscreen: "Why does raw engine analysis fail chess players?"
rows.narration: "Ever stared at a Stockfish evaluation of plus three point two... and had no idea what it actually means?"
rows.sound: Soft, subtle tension drone. Sharp chess piece click.

rows.visual: Split screen: Confused young player looking at raw engine numbers: Centipawn loss: 148. Blunder: Nd5. Quick red flashes on missed pins and forks.
rows.brief: Split screen: Confused young player looking at raw engine numbers: Centipawn loss: 148. Blunder: Nd5. Quick red flashes on missed pins and forks.
onscreen: Stockfish gives numbers. You need coaching.
rows.narration: "Engines give cold numbers and computer lines no human would play. They don't teach you *why you blundered, or how to fix it."*
rows.sound: Synth tick rhythm builds up. Disappointment buzz sound.

rows.visual: Smooth transition to the sleek dark/gold Chessmasters interface. User pastes a Lichess or Chess.com game link. Status badge streams: Fetching game... Analyzing centipawn loss... Generating coaching report.
rows.brief: Smooth transition to the sleek dark/gold Chessmasters interface. User pastes a Lichess or Chess.com game link. Status badge streams: Fetching game... Analyzing centipawn loss... Generating coaching report.
onscreen: Meet Chessmasters. Paste any game link.
rows.narration: "Meet Chessmasters. Just paste your Lichess or Chess.com game. In fifteen seconds, our AI Grandmaster breaks down your match in plain English."
rows.sound: Beat drop kicks in! Smooth whoosh as URL is pasted. Satisfying chime on stream start.

rows.visual: Fast, dynamic zoom into the 5 core sections: Strengths (green badge), Weaknesses (amber badge), Turning Point with interactive board arrow showing the blunder, and Psychology radar showing time trouble.
rows.brief: Fast, dynamic zoom into the 5 core sections: Strengths (green badge), Weaknesses (amber badge), Turning Point with interactive board arrow showing the blunder, and Psychology radar showing time trouble.
onscreen: • Narrative Strengths & Weaknesses • Critical Turning Point Board • Tilt & Time Trouble Detection
rows.narration: "Discover your exact strengths, your critical tactical blind spots, and the psychological moments where time trouble or tilt cost you the win."
rows.sound: Rhythmic digital UI pulses, crisp card transition swooshes.

rows.visual: The report generates one-click practice links directly to Lichess tactical drills: Deflection, Knight Fork, King Safety. A cursor clicks a drill and the exact puzzle appears ready to solve.
rows.brief: The report generates one-click practice links directly to Lichess tactical drills: Deflection, Knight Fork, King Safety. A cursor clicks a drill and the exact puzzle appears ready to solve.
rows.narration: "Best of all, Chessmasters turns your blunders into instant training drills. One click, and you're mastering the exact tactic you missed."
rows.sound: Positive uplifting chord progression. Puzzle piece snap sound.

rows.visual: Wide shot of the complete dashboard on desktop and phone. Premium gold typography shines: Chessmasters. URL displays clearly with a badge: First 5 Analyses Free.
rows.brief: Wide shot of the complete dashboard on desktop and phone. Premium gold typography shines: Chessmasters. URL displays clearly with a badge: First 5 Analyses Free.
rows.narration: "Stop guessing. Start mastering. Paste your first game free right now at chessmasters.in."
rows.sound: Upbeat musical climax and clean acoustic reverb resolve.
